gist.summary: Removed aitoolbox.software (#3400) from the app catalog because its domain no longer hosts the listed AI toolbox and now serves a gambling site. Catalog validation passes with 857 apps.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden of app cards, Polli gently lifts an outdated toolbox card off the display while flowers grow around the remaining cards. Polli is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny gardener's hat; she is small within the scene, rendered in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874) and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
